name: browser-use
headline: cc-spec-driven: manage requirements docs
short_description: A Claude Code plugin for managing requirement documents, tracking changes, and outputting specs. Enables downstream tools to generate code based on high-quality specs and complete E2E testing. Benefits operations teams by ensuring consistency and traceability in software development.
author: mkhrdev

sections.overview:
cc-spec-driven is a Claude Code plugin that manages requirement documents, tracks changes through change records (CRs), and generates specifications for downstream code generation and testing. It implements a spec-driven, document-first workflow where confirmed documents serve as the single source of truth for development and E2E testing. The plugin automates dependency tracking, maintains consistency across feature documents, and prevents common documentation errors through engineering-level hooks. Teams use it to incrementally enrich requirements, track requirement changes with CR-ID references, and enable AI-assisted code generation and test case creation based on high-quality specs.
Initialize and manage product requirements with automatic change tracking and CR numbering
Generate development and test specifications from confirmed requirement documents
Track feature dependencies and detect missed dependency changes during confirmation
Create reusable E2E test cases with version control and CR-ID naming
